desc:
Run your own electronics repair shop!

Customers walk in with broken handhelds, phones, game consoles, radios and more. Open them up, find the fault, order parts on the shop PC, fix what's broken and clean out the dust and grime. Hand it back and get paid.

Grow your workshop:
• Buy better tools and licenses to take on harder jobs
• Learn soldering and bring dead boards back to life
• Refurbish devices and sell them for a profit
• Decorate your shop with themes, tool skins and stickers

Play your way:
• Solo story mode with a full tutorial
• Co-op: run one shop together with a friend
• 1v1 and 2v2 repair battles: same device, first valid repair wins

Log in every day for daily rewards, and check the update log on the home screen for what's new.

Works on computer, phone, tablet and controller. Plays in English and Spanish.
